## Known to exist — copy sought
The full title and corporate author on this page still come from [jordanforge-infrastructure issue 10](https://github.com/jordanforge-ca/jordanforge-infrastructure/issues/10). Public catalogue and web searches in 2026 did **not** independently confirm a library holding, ISBN, or inspected copy. The item remains attested by the commissioning issue only.
:::

## Annotation

This remains a catalogue placeholder. Unlike the [ECPM skill-development manual](wanted-ecpm-manuals.qmd), which is cited by title in a later public bibliography, *Keys on Freedom* was not located in the public catalogues and sites checked for this pass.

BC Rehabilitation Society (B.C. Rehab) is independently attested as an organization in [Nancy Clay’s 1993 UBC thesis](clay-1993-pearson.qmd), which used B.C. Rehab documents and described Creekview as a community-living move from George Pearson Centre. That thesis does **not** cite *Keys on Freedom*.

## Open questions

- Whether the manual was published, circulated internally, or only planned.
- Exact publication date, edition, and author names on any title page.
- Whether and how it relates to the 1990 ECPM *Skill Development Manual* from BC Rehab and Greater Vancouver Home Support Society.
- Location of a copy (GF Strong / Pearson successor files, SCI BC, ministry, private papers).

## Search leads still worth following

- Legislative Library of British Columbia government-publications files
- UBC and SFU special collections / BC Rehab deposit copies
- SCI BC / former Canadian Paraplegic Association BC library
